results.title: ‘The Super Mario Galaxy Movie’ Just Broke a Rare Box Office Record - Newsweek
results.content:
“The Super Mario Galaxy Movie” is the first movie to cross $1 billion at the 2026 box office.
It’s now the highest-grossing film of the year by a margin of over $100 million, followed by Michael Jackson biopic “Michael” with $888 million, and “Project Hail Mary” with $679 million, as per Box Office Mojo.

results.title: Project Hail Mary Is Already The Biggest Hollywood Movie Of 2026 At The Box Office
results.content:
Heading into 2026, "Project Hail Mary" felt like by far one of the biggest box office gambles any studio was making this year.
Amazon MGM Studios gets to stand tall, because it's already the highest-grossing Hollywood movie of the year thus far.
